# Conditional minimal GPU-DDR discriminating experiment — R22r1/UTW1 candidate
## Plan only. TERMINATION BOUNDARY: scratch-isolation proof (or its impossibility). Draft for reviewer validation; nothing has been executed.

## 0. Scope
- This artifact is a plan, not a script. All DDR payloads are symbolic (S, T_J, T_C, T_C2, T_G, T_K); no concrete GPU command words or OpenOCD write commands are emitted. No bitstream build, no controller mutation, no runnable DDR writes, no Linux start, no large DDR writes.
- Root-only window: load candidate R22r1 verifying SHA55601256120915adbb08279c0b6bd42caabf8deff261bf87b8a7b8d8cbf9c8aa (netlist 0eb5638a…4cb191), run milestones D1→D3, then restore R19 verifying SHA1056917bf942ea2eaf9541b9abbb3997a8ad45eb78fc09e9432f73f3e209917c. STA FAIL (setup −1.013 gpu busy_sync, recovery −0.212 gpu capture) stands: no qualification claim; this window is the entire exposure.

## 1. Evidence (cited) vs hypotheses
- E1 Opcode 22 = TARGET set: color/z bases w1/w2[29:0] (byte fields), dims w3, strides w4; path TARGET_WAIT→CHECK→PIPE→VALIDATE; TARGET states are not in `native_issue` ⇒ no DDR request (gpu_v1.v L386-390, L132-135, L440-443); corroborated by tools/neo/memory_probe.S L67 "TARGET does no DMA".
- E2 Opcode 28 = CLEAR: flags w1[1:0], color w2[15:0], depth w3[15:0] (gpu_v1.v L424-427) → RECT pipeline; color native write at RECT_COLOR: addr={color_addr[28:3],3'b0}, data={16{clear_color}}, mask=rect_mask (L601-610); bad_clear bounds L277; empty-rect skip L593-596; row-loop single-row exit L617-622.
- E3 Address units: targets/textures = BYTE addresses, native DDR requests = WORD addresses; color_addr=(byte offset)>>2 (L469, L602); DQ32 IP = 256-bit bursts = 32 B, word addresses (ddr_subsys.v L102-103).
- E4 CPU/AHB path uses byte haddr and its own mask convention (ahb_ddr_cdc.v L57-63, L71); adapt layer: IP addr = bytes/4, mask "1 = byte not written" (ddr_ui_adapt.v L9, L104). Never mix the two masters' units when predicting W.
- E5 Precedents: scratch 0x12000000 in DDR lower half (memory_probe.S L1, L27; RING upper half 0x20000000 — ae350_soc.v L170-171); CPU stores + `fence iorw,iorw` (L50, L86, L107); ILM probe with park back to ROM loop jr 0x80000000 (L106-109), trap logging (L111-119); MMIO blit port 0xe9001000 ID 0x424c5432, cmd FIFO +0x10, counter +0x8, counter+1-per-accepted-descriptor poll (L68-97; gpu_target first word 0x16000000 = opcode 22, L122-124).
- E6 Guard precedent: parked CPU priv=3 satp=0, pc 0x80000000/04, ROM wfi/j, display parked on internal bars, idle GPU/NCP counters, UTNA fresh (r19_initial_guard.tcl L3-12, L14-21, L24-27). Counters can latch a prior snapshot until a new request (packet, run 20261028_133840 first-diagnostic lesson): interpret only fresh reads taken after the request under test.
- H1 (unproven) suppled gpu_v1.v is frozen-R19 ancestry, not the R22r1 netlist itself; the 0xe9001000 block being this pixel engine is inferred, not proven.
- H2 (unproven) 0x12000000 decodes to DDR on R22r1 (tool-header evidence only).
- H3 (limitation) AE350 D-cache line semantics and any invalidate primitive are absent from the packet; fence orders CPU-side ops only. Debugger reads may traverse the hart LSU and see stale lines. Therefore: a T_G sighting is conclusive; absence of change is INCONCLUSIVE, never "GPU write failed".
- H4 (RTL-only) 32-bit GPU mask polarity (covered pixel pairs = 00 ⇒ written; rect_mask=0 for a full 16-px chunk, L292-295).
- H5 (unknown) counter semantics and one-burst latency; no frequency may be inferred, so timeouts are in read counts, not seconds.

## 2. M0 preconditions — all required, else STOP-0
(1) Guard replay passes (E6 items). (2) Scanout request/return counters 0. (3) UTW1 4/4 coherent version 1. (4) ddr_init done (led_n deasserted, console_neo.v L205). (5) USB host device absent, no host traffic. (6) Bind S=0x12000000 (32-byte-aligned candidate per H2; an ownership claim is NOT made by binding).

## 3. D1 — CPU/JTAG pattern vs true CPU execution must be distinct (isolation gate)
Window W = [S−0x40, S+0x80). Debugger first: write T_J at S[0..15], read back =T_J (debugger path reaches S as decoded).
CPU probe (ILM, resumed from park; statuses to the memory_probe-style status block): (a) read S[0..15] → CPU log L1; (b) write T_C at S[0..15]; (c) write T_C2 at S[0x10..0x20] (never debugger-touched — negative control); (d) write T_K across W\{S..S+0x20} (canary strips, incl. Z-window zone); (e) `fence iorw,iorw`; park to 0x80000000.
Debugger re-read W: require S[0..15]=T_C, S[0x10..0x20]=T_C2, canaries=T_K.
Distinctness: byte constants T_J, T_C, T_C2, T_K and both bytes of 16-bit T_G pairwise distinct, so every author is identifiable in any view.
Pass = cross-view agreement on CPU-authored tags ⇒ true CPU execution on DDR evidenced. FAIL/ambiguity ⇒ STOP-A: isolation NOT proved; restore R19 immediately.
Rule: CPU loads of W occur only BEFORE the corresponding CPU stores; after parking, the CPU never loads W again — post-GPU observation is debugger-only (bounds H3).

## 4. D2 — TARGET-only control (opcode 22 must be distinct from CLEAR)
CPU probe: verify ID at 0xe9001000 = 0x424c5432 (E5); send TARGET with bases S (color), S+0x40 (z), width 16, height 1, color_stride = z_stride = 0x20, all reserved zero (valid per gpu_v1.v L279-284: base[4:0]=0, strides multiple of 32, ≥ width·2, ends ≤ 0x400000000, no color/z overlap); poll, park.
Require: blit counter delta = +1 for the descriptor (precedent L73-95; anomalies ⇒ inconclusive-STOP), scanout stays 0, debugger W bitwise unchanged (T_C/T_C2/T_K intact; T_G absent).
Distinctness: identical command path and identical target configuration; the sole delta to D3 is the opcode word (0x16↔0x1C) and payload fields. Any W change here ⇒ STOP-B: TARGET touches DDR contrary to E1/H1 — stop and report.

## 5. D3 — minimal CLEAR burst (opcode 28): footprint, mask, canaries, timeout
Sequence in one probe run: re-issue TARGET 22 (same params; TARGET_VALIDATE resets scissor to full target, L442) → scissor (0,0,16,1) via opcode 23 (needs target_valid, L266-267) → CLEAR w1=0b01 (color only; no Z request), w2=T_G, w3=0, w0[23:0]=0, w4..w7=0 (bad_clear L277). px=0, span=16 ⇒ room=16 (L142), chunk_count=16, one chunk, one row (exit L617-622) ⇒ exactly one native write (H4 mask: all 32 B covered).
Expected footprint — SYMBOLIC until D1+D2+D3 all pass: one aligned 32-byte burst; native word addr = (S>>2) & ~7 (S 32-aligned ⇒ base S); bytes [S, S+0x20) ← T_G ×16 lanes; every other byte of W bitwise preserved.
Timeout: poll 0xe9001008 with cap P = 100000 CPU reads (≈2× the E5 precedent 50000, L87; count-based — H5). On cap: park, snapshot W and counters, STOP-D. Root-side wall-clock watchdog aborts the whole procedure to STOP-D regardless.
Verdict (H3-safe): debugger re-read W. T_G sighted in [S,S+0x20) AND all canaries = T_K ⇒ scratch isolation PROVED (record both views, W hashes before/after, counter deltas, UTW1 captures). Any outer byte ≠ T_K ⇒ footprint unproven ⇒ STOP-D. T_G absent or canary reads ambiguous ⇒ INCONCLUSIVE ⇒ STOP-E (missing proof: cache path H3; do not claim GPU-write failure).
Post-verdict: park CPU; fresh-read blit counter (+1 expected per 22/23/28 descriptor) and NCP idle counters (E6); restore R19 SHA-verified; close the candidate window.

## 6. Stop conditions (STOP-n ⇒ park CPU, snapshot evidence incl. UTW1 captures, restore R19 SHA-verified, report; no retries, no address scanning, no Linux start)
(0) M0 fails. (A) D1 view mismatch. (B) TARGET-only changes W. (D) outer-byte change, timeout cap, or watchdog. (E) D3 inconclusive under H3. (F) UTW1 incoherence or scanout ≠ 0 at any checkpoint. (T) CPU-probe trap (mcause surfaced per L111-119).

## 7. Acceptance mapping
- Opcodes 22 target / 28 clear: E1/E2 (ancestry RTL; netlist opcode-table equality itself unproven — H1, exercised behaviorally only by the D2↔D3 delta).
- Bytes vs word addressing: E3/E4 for both masters.
- Cache/fence limitations: H3 — CPU fence orders CPU stores but cannot prove GPU-write visibility; no invalidate primitive in packet; a sighting is conclusive, absence is inconclusive.
- Exact write footprint: symbolic formula over S until D1+D2+D3 pass; only then the concrete claim is "32 bytes of one aligned chunk, canaries intact". Total symbolically-touched DDR ≤ ~0x110 bytes.
- Stop-and-report: conditions above; nothing beyond the isolation boundary is planned.
